pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to positions until the primary trade achieves a minimum of +$10.00 in floating profit and moves the active stop-loss to break-even.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory ATR volatility expansion check: Do not enter XAUUSD unless current 5-period ATR exceeds the 20-period moving average of ATR by at least 15%.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate trailing stop protocol or scale out 50% of volume once profit hits +$15.00, letting the remaining size run toward the +$30.00 target.
